description: Thermal contact model: R(T) = R_ref*(1+alpha_contact*(T-T_ref)); ampacity limit from IEC 62271-1; standby heating from auxiliary draw; skin-effect correction at HV.

unit.name: Generic 11 kV Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB), 630 A
unit.source: ABB Circuit Breaker Application Guide (2021); IEC 62271-100:2021; IEC 62271-1; Greenwood (1991) Electrical Transients in Power Systems. Wiley.

R_cb_ohm.note: Closed-state contact resistance at T_ref=20 C (100 uOhm, MV VCB typical)

alpha_contact.note: Copper contacts: same as bulk Cu, 0.00393 /K

T_max_contact.note: IEC 62271-1 Cl.4.4: 105 C max contact temperature for Cu contacts

P_aux_W.note: Standby auxiliary power (control coil, cubicle heater, indicator lamps)

r_conductor_mm.note: Approximate conductor radius for skin effect (busbars in VCB)

I_A.note: Up to 125% rated for short-time overload
